name: Joe Osborn
summary: Joe Osborn was a Dunwich local who guided Dr. Armitage's party in the right direction up Sentinel Hill and later pressed the Arkham men to explain what the horror had truly been.
description: When Armitage inadvertently took a wrong direction, Joe Osborn warned him and walked ahead to show the right one. Later, after the creature's destruction, Osborn interrupted old Zebulon Whateley to press the Arkham men for an explanation of what the thing had been and how young Wizard Whateley had called it out of the air.
